description: This file defines an abstract base class for activation rebalancing tests in Orleans, including related interfaces and a simple grain implementation. It sets up test infrastructure, manages silo addresses, and provides utility methods for testing activation counts and variance calculations.

classes.name: RebalancingTestBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for setting up activation rebalancing tests, managing silo addresses, and providing utility methods.

classes.name: IRebalancingTestGrain
classes.description: Interface defining a test grain with a Ping method.

classes.name: RebalancingTestGrain
classes.description: A simple implementation of IRebalancingTestGrain that completes the Ping task immediately.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Counts the number of activations on a specific silo based on grain statistics.

methods.name: AddTestActivations
methods.description: Adds a specified number of test grain activations to a given silo.

methods.name: CalculateVariance
methods.description: Calculates the statistical variance of an array of integer values.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by forcing activation collection.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: A simple method that completes immediately, used for testing grain activation.
